title: TSMC CoWoS advanced packaging
summary: The packaging technology that attaches HBM to AI accelerators, and a hard capacity limit.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Chip-on-wafer-on-substrate packaging places accelerator dies and HBM stacks on a silicon interposer, which is how high-bandwidth memory reaches the GPU. TSMC has doubled CoWoS capacity repeatedly and still cannot meet demand, making packaging a gating factor for AI accelerator shipments. The technology is a moat as much as a process node.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Mass production
Estimated window 2023–2028
Confidence label Confident
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

When packaging is the bottleneck, capacity announcements from the packager move the entire AI supply chain.

What Would Change The View

  • CoWoS capacity additions.
  • Yield on larger interposers.
  • Alternative packaging from Samsung and Intel.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
